\begin{table}[!htbp]
  \centering
  \caption{Nomenclature: symbols used in the main analysis.}
  \label{tab:nomenclature}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{lXXX}
    \toprule
    Symbol & Meaning & How obtained & Used for \\
    \midrule
    $R$ & distance-compatible background &
      frozen distance-sector endpoint & reference deformation \\
    $C_{1}$ & Planck-compatible endpoint 1 &
      Planck TT/TE/EE calibrated CAMB reference & CMB reference \\
    $C_{2}$ & Planck-compatible endpoint 2 &
      secondary Planck/CAMB baseline & robustness reference \\
    $\Delta_{1}$ & $\ln H_{R}(z)-\ln H_{C_{1}}(z)$ &
      derived & comparison \\
    $\Delta_{2}$ & $\ln H_{R}(z)-\ln H_{C_{2}}(z)$ &
      derived & comparison \\
    $\Delta_{C}$ & $\ln H_{C_{1}}(z)-\ln H_{C_{2}}(z)$ &
      derived & reference spread \\
    $K_{H}$ & overall amplitude of the bridge map &
      fitted (bridge coordinate) & compact representation \\
    $c_{j}$ & Legendre shape coefficients ($j=0,1,2$) &
      fitted (bridge coordinates) & compact representation \\
    m3 & Legendre order-3 reconstruction &
      CV-selected & compact representation \\
    $\epsilon$ & reciprocity parameter &
      profiled & diagnostic only \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}
